paragraphs.text: 1. I SAW thee meditating in thy spirit what sprang from Fervour and hath thence developed.
paragraphs.original: अपश्यं त्वा मनसा चेकितानं तपसो जातं तपसो विभूतम् ।
paragraphs.translit: apaśyaṃ tvā manasā cekitānaṃ tapaso jātaṃ tapaso vibhūtam |

paragraphs.text: Bestowing offspring here, bestowing riches, spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.
paragraphs.original: इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकाम
paragraphs.translit: iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇaḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāma

paragraphs.text: 2. I saw thee pondering in thine heart, and praying that in due time thy body might be fruitful.
paragraphs.original: अपश्यं त्वा मनसा दीध्यानां स्वायां तनू ऋत्व्ये नाधमानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: apaśyaṃ tvā manasā dīdhyānāṃ svāyāṃ tanū ṛtvye nādhamānām |

paragraphs.text: Come as a youthful woman, rise to meet me: spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.
paragraphs.original: उप मामुच्चा युवतिर्बभूयाः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकामे
paragraphs.translit: upa māmuccā yuvatirbabhūyāḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāme

paragraphs.text: 3. In plants and herbs, in all existent beings I have deposited the germ of increase.
All progeny on earth have I engendered, and sons in women who will be hereafter.
paragraphs.original: अहं प्रजा अजनयं पृथिव्यामहं जनिभ्यो अपरीषु पुत्रान्
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ prajā ajanayaṃ pṛthivyāmahaṃ janibhyo aparīṣu putrān
